name: sankey/nightly-check/align-nodes-left.mmd
text:
---
description: >-
  Two parallel paths (a->b->c->d->e and x->c->y) sharing node c, at a fixed
  width of 410 with useMaxWidth disabled, so node x-positions are deterministic.
  sankey.nodeAlignment is set to "left".
config:
  sankey:
    nodeAlignment: left
    width: 410
    useMaxWidth: false
---
sankey

  a,b,8
  b,c,8
  c,d,8
  d,e,8

  x,c,4
  c,y,4

name: sankey/nightly-check/custom-node-colors.mmd
text:
---
description: >-
  A two-link sankey chain (a->b->c) with sankey.nodeColors explicitly set for
  both a and b.

  sankey:
    nodeColors:
      a: '#ff0000'
      b: '#00ff00'

  b,c,20

name: sankey/nightly-check/fallback-colors-for-unspecified-nodes.mmd
text:
---
description: >-
  A two-link sankey chain (a->b->c) with sankey.nodeColors set only for node a —
  node b (and c) are expected to fall back to the default palette rather than
  reuse a's colour.
config:
  sankey:
    nodeColors:
      a: '#ff0000'
---
sankey
  a,b,10
  b,c,20

name: sankey/pr-check/should-render-a-simple-example.mmd
text:
---
description: >-
  Minimal sankey-beta diagram with a single CSV link between two nodes, no
  config overrides.
---
sankey-beta

  sourceNode,targetNode,10

name: sankey/pr-check/should-render-complete-financial-flow-with-custom-colors.mmd
text:
---
description: >-
  Sankey diagram of an Apple-style financial flow (product lines into
  Revenue, through Cost of Revenue, Gross Profit, Op Expenses/Profit, Tax,
  Net Profit) exercising the full set of sankey config options: explicit
  width/height, outlined label style, showValues, a $/B prefix/suffix, and
  per-node custom colors. Superset of should-render-labels-with-apple-
  style-outlined-text.mmd, which uses the same link data but only sets
  width/height/labelStyle.
config:
  sankey:
    width: 800
    height: 500
    labelStyle: outlined
    showValues: true
    prefix: $
    suffix: B
    nodeColors:
      iPhone: '#6e6e73'
      Mac: '#6e6e73'
      iPad: '#6e6e73'
      Wearables: '#6e6e73'
      Products: '#6e6e73'
      Services: '#6e6e73'
      Revenue: '#424245'
      Cost of Revenue: '#ff3b30'
      Gross Profit: '#34c759'
      Op Expenses: '#ff3b30'
      Op Profit: '#34c759'
      Tax: '#ff3b30'
      Net Profit: '#34c759'
---
sankey

  iPhone,Products,205
  Mac,Products,40
  iPad,Products,29
  Wearables,Products,41
  Products,Revenue,315
  Services,Revenue,78
  Revenue,Cost of Revenue,223
  Revenue,Gross Profit,170
  Gross Profit,Op Expenses,51
  Gross Profit,Op Profit,119
  Op Profit,Tax,19
  Op Profit,Net Profit,100

name: sankey/pr-check/should-render-labels-with-apple-style-outlined-text.mmd
text:
---
description: >-
  Sankey diagram of the same Apple-style financial flow data as should-
  render-complete-financial-flow-with-custom-colors.mmd, but only setting
  width/height and labelStyle: outlined (no showValues, prefix/suffix, or
  per-node colors), isolating the outlined-label-text rendering path.
config:
  sankey:
    width: 800
    height: 500
    labelStyle: outlined
---
sankey

  iPhone,Products,205
  Mac,Products,40
  iPad,Products,29
  Wearables,Products,41
  Products,Revenue,315
  Services,Revenue,78
  Revenue,Cost of Revenue,223
  Revenue,Gross Profit,170
  Gross Profit,Op Expenses,51
  Gross Profit,Op Profit,119
  Op Profit,Tax,19
  Op Profit,Net Profit,100
